kaa.mistake_note_md: Tamır astındaǵı sanlardı tikkeley qosıw/ayırıw ($\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}\ne\sqrt{a+b}$); kóbeytiwshini shıǵarǵanda kvadrat tamırın alıwdı umıtıw.

en.solution_md: Take the factor out of the root: $\sqrt{3}=\sqrt{3}$, $\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}$, $\sqrt{147}=7\sqrt{3}$. Sum: $(1-2+7)\sqrt{3}=6\sqrt{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Adding radicands directly ($\sqrt{a}+\sqrt{b}\ne\sqrt{a+b}$); forgetting to take the root of the factor being extracted.
